steps.en: Clone the repo and let uv build its locked Python 3.11 + CUDA 12.8 environment
steps.zh: 克隆仓库，用 uv 装好锁定版本的环境

steps.en: Download the IndexTTS-2.5 weights into checkpoints/
steps.zh: 把 IndexTTS-2.5 权重下载到 checkpoints/

steps.en: Loads the speech GPT, semantic codec, s2mel and vocoder; fetches the small helper models on first run
steps.zh: 加载语音 GPT、语义编解码器、s2mel 和声码器，首次运行补下小模型

steps.en: Call infer with the text, its language, a clip of the voice and a separate clip of the mood
steps.zh: 调用 infer，传入文字、语种、音色录音和另一段情绪录音

steps.en: Splits the text into segments; a GPT writes speech tokens with the clip's timbre and the other clip's emotion
steps.zh: 把文字切段，GPT 按音色和情绪分别取自两段录音写出语音 token

steps.en: A flow-matching model paints the spectrogram; BigVGAN renders 22.05 kHz audio and the segments are stitched
steps.zh: 流匹配模型画出频谱，BigVGAN 合成 22.05 kHz 音频并拼成 WAV

value.en: One voice reading any line in five languages with an emotion you pick separately — no sad re-take from the speaker, no per-character API bill
value.zh: 同一个声音用五种语言之一念任意台词，情绪单独指定——不必再找本人录一段伤心版，也不按字付费

sources: https://github.com/index-tts/index-tts README (Getting Started: uv sync --all-extras; Download Models: hf download IndexTeam/IndexTTS-2.5 --local-dir=checkpoints; Python API: from indextts.infer_v2_5 import IndexTTS2; tts.infer(spk_audio_prompt='examples/voice_07.wav', text=text, lang="ZH", output_path="gen.wav", emo_audio_prompt="examples/emo_sad.wav", verbose=True))

https://github.com/index-tts/index-tts indextts/infer_v2_5.py (IndexTTS2.__init__ loads UnifiedVoice GPT, semantic codec codec.pth, s2mel, CAMPPlus and BigVGAN, calling ensure_models_available for w2v-BERT/CAMPPlus/BigVGAN; infer_generator segments text by max_text_tokens_per_segment=120, sampling_rate = 22050, inserts interval silence and saves output_path)
https://github.com/index-tts/index-tts pyproject.toml (requires-python >=3.10,<3.12; torch==2.8.* from the cu128 index)
